description: Canonical ACTION vocabulary — the portability-maximal layer of PAER. A policy constrains an action (verb + resource); the event is only a binding. Verbs are stable; the resource grammar is per-verb.

verbs.resource: path glob (repo-relative; absolute only with a declared root)
verbs.title: Read a file or resource
Create, edit or delete a file

verbs.resource: MCP tool name as the harness sends it, glob, case-insensitive (mcp__server__tool on Claude Code and Codex, server_tool on OpenCode, MCP:tool on Cursor); write *server* to span harnesses
verbs.title: Call a tool provided by an MCP server

verbs.resource: pattern over the text a tool returned, case-insensitive; bound to the tool.post event only, where it can only add a note
verbs.title: Read what a tool returned

verbs.resource: pattern over the final message of an agent turn, case-insensitive; bound to the turn.stop event only, where a deny asks the agent to keep going once
verbs.title: Let the agent stop

verbs.resource: pattern over the text of a user prompt, case-insensitive; bound to the prompt.submit event only
verbs.title: Submit a prompt to the agent

excluded.reason: consulting a skill is a discipline, not a security action
